officialEuropeSizeGuide.evidence: Official size guide lists boot-size, boot-sole-length, rider-weight and rider-height guidance by Café Racer size. Its 159 rider-weight range is 55–90 kg, while the North American product-page table says 55–85 kg; retain both source values and do not silently choose one.
